---
name: adr-and-checkpoint-reporting
description: "Use when recording an architecture decision, phase handoff, checkpoint report, risk, or unresolved choice in Gate-OS."
---

## Procedure
For an ADR, record context, options, decision, consequences, status, and evidence. For a checkpoint, record scope, completed work, files, commands/results, plan deltas, risks, and one concise decision question if blocked.

## Verification
Decision is discoverable, owners and next steps are named, evidence is reproducible, and the Orchestrator has reviewed integration impact.
